description: Run deterministic offline anti-slop rules on draft text (0 credits, no login required; read-only). Use first before dislop_review or dislop_deslop.

filename.description: Optional virtual filename hint (e.g. draft.md or page.html) for modality detection

modality.description: Explicit format override when filename is omitted

pack.description: Scenario rule pack ID or auto to route by modality and content

register.description: Optional writing register to calibrate style thresholds

text.description: Draft text, Markdown, HTML/CSS/JSX, or SVG source to inspect

verbose.description: Include full rule descriptions (default false for compact output)

name: dislop_check
